I have only 0.22 hectares on this plot, so buying a full bag of chemical fertilizer does not make sense for me when the money could go to my larger fields, and as a woman I do not have extra cash to risk on inputs that might not pay back on such a small piece. I will spread manure from my cattle on it because I own this land and I want to keep the soil strong for the coming years, and I will use seed I saved from last season rather than buying new packets. My children and I will do all the work ourselves, spending about 30 days on this plot over the season, and I will not pay for hired labor or for any sprays since we can pull the weeds by hand.
